description: Top-20 behavior clone with 10,000 postflop hard states relabeled by the stateless current submission safety teacher

teacher.name: current-submission-stateless
teacher.memory: isolated context per state; no cross-hand adaptation
teacher.claim: safety pseudo-labels, not solver or equilibrium labels

dataset.replacement_policy: replace matching train labels in place

promotion_gate.offline: must not regress untouched validation/test metrics materially
promotion_gate.runtime: zero illegal actions and zero timeouts
promotion_gate.paired: confidence-gated hybrid must beat the current submission with a positive 95% lower bound
